The '''Lufu language''' is a [[Yukubenic]] language of [[Nigeria]], still spoken mostly by older adults among the Lufu people of the [[Takum|Takum Local Government Authority]], [[Taraba State]]; its speakers have mostly shifted to [[Jukun Takum language|Jukun]]. It is close to [[Bete language (Nigeria)|Bete]].
